title: Get Bestselling Videos
content:
# Path: /analytics/202511/videos/bestselling
# Method: [GET]
# Function Description
Returns up to 100 videos ranked by gross merchandise value (GMV) in descending order for the date range selected by `date` and `time_slot`.

---


# Common Parameters
For common parameters, refer to [How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f199679495ef0281851ee5#Back%20To%20Top)
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Location <!-- width:75px --> | Type <!-- width:75px --> | Require <!-- width:60px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shop_cipher | query | string | Y | GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 | Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. |
| Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9) |  |  |  |  |  |
| content-type | header | string | Y | application/json | Allowed type: application/json |
# Request Query Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| app_key | string | Y | 38abcd | Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app. |
| sign | string | Y | 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c | Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders. |
| timestamp | int | Y | 1623812664 | Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |
| date | string | Y | 2025-11-13 | The reference date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in the shop's registered timezone. The query calculates data backwards from this date based on `time_slot` (for example, `7D` returns data for the 7 days ending on this date). This date is inclusive and must be on or before the latest available data date. |
| time_slot | string | Y | 7D | The length of the query period ending on `date`. Supported values are: |

* 1D: 1 day
* 7D: 7 days
* 30D: 30 days |
   currency |string |N |USD |Currency for monetary values. Use `USD` for US dollars or `LOCAL` for the local currency where the shop is registered. If omitted, the default is `LOCAL`. |

# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202511/videos/bestselling?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&date=2025-11-13&time_slot=7D&currency=USD
```

# Response Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:289px --> | Properties description <!-- width:289px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | int | 0 | The success or failure status code returned in API response. |
| message | string | Success | The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message. |
| request_id | string | 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 | Request log |
| data | object |  | Specific return information |
| ^videos | []object |  | List of bestselling video records for the target date range. |
| ^^rank | int | 1 | Gmv rank of the video |
| ^^id | string | 10484583 | Video id |
| ^^nick_name | string | abc_bec | Creator handle |
| ^^gmv_range | string | $97000.00~$191000.00 | Gmv range of the video |
| ^^views | int | 939829 | Accumulative number of video views since the video was published. |
| ^^likes | int | 83894 | Accumulative number of video likes since the video was published. |
| ^^comments | int | 1934 | Accumulative number of video comments since the video was published. |
| ^^shares | int | 223 | Accumulative number of video shares since the video was published. |
| ^^product_infos | []object |  | List of product anchors associated with the video, including product IDs and product names. Excludes deactivated and sold-out products. |
| ^^^product_id | string | 1731736614984386107 | Product ID in the product anchor. Excludes deactivated and sold-out products. |
| ^^^product_name | string | labubu | Product name in the product anchor. Deactivated and sold-out products are excluded. |
| ^^publish_time | int | 1623812664 | The time when the video was published, as a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC). |
| ^^duration | int | 7602 | Duration of the video, in seconds. |
